bookTitle: Fundamentals of Futures and Options Markets (John C. Hull)
subject: finance

futures.definition: A standardized legal agreement to buy or sell a commodity or asset at a predetermined price at a specified time in the future.

options.definition: A financial derivative that gives the buyer the right, but not the obligation, to buy or sell an underlying asset at an agreed-upon price.

strikePrice.definition: The set price at which a derivative contract can be bought or sold when exercised.

premium.definition: The total price an investor pays to purchase an option contract.

persona.contextDescription: Indian derivatives market (NSE, Nifty, BankNifty) and commodity forwards.
